messages:
Ethan Perez: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get clarity on release cadence (minor vs major), oncall rotation changes, and how SLAs/quality bars are being communicated to customers?
Leah Kim: Short version: minors aim weekly, majors quarterly. Dedicated customers can opt into faster minor patches via a patch window. We'll publish the full cadence doc and owners by EOD.
Ethan Perez: Where will the cadence doc live and who owns the final go/no-go?
Leah Kim: Confluence + pinned in #eng-releases. Release owner is the release-week oncall + PM lead; SRE runs post-release checks and rollback authority is with the oncall if thresholds hit.
Kai Patel: Heads-up on oncall: shifting to 4-week rotations starting next month. Ops coverage window for minors Mon-Fri 10:00-18:00 PT. Majors require a candidate week + 48h blackout. Example config: 
```
release_window:
  minor: weekdays 10:00-18:00 PT
  major: candidate_week + 48h_blackout
```
Maya Singh: Quality bar notes: no critical regressions, P95 tail latency variance <5% from baseline for a release to pass. Evals should be in PRs and we want smoke tests added to the checklist.
Samir Rao: SLA question — when do we publish Dedicated SLA numbers so sales/customer success can communicate?
Leah Kim: Draft SLA is with Legal/Product. Targets: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated standard, 99.95% for premium. Final wording + credits pending legal signoff.
Jamie Torres: On oncall handoffs — can we add overlap? Current handoffs are tight and sometimes miss context.
Kai Patel: Yes — adding a 1h overlap to rotations and a handoff template. Template snippet: 
```
handoff:
  summary: <incidents/ongoing tasks>
  breadcrumbs: <links/logs/traces>
```
Ethan Perez: Any changes to rollback policy thresholds?
Leah Kim: Rollback stays automated based on canary metrics. Current thresholds: error rate >1% OR latency P95 > 2x baseline triggers forced rollback. We'll publish exact numbers and tooling commands.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release v0.9.12 scheduled for 2025-08-12 16:00 UTC :calendar: 
Maya Singh: I'll coordinate pre-release evals with QA and add the smoke test checklist. :raised_hands:
Samir Rao: Can we standardize a release checklist/template repo file we can review?
Leah Kim: Yes — checklist will be in Confluence and a repo-level `/releases/CHECKLIST.md`. Ping me or Dir of Eng if you need edit access.
Ethan Perez: Awesome, thanks. Can leadership publish a follow-up doc with timelines and owners within 48h?
Leah Kim: Yep — I'll publish a follow-up with timelines, rotation calendar, and owners by EOD tomorrow.
